hooks.name: Keep SSE-to-3D spec in sync
hooks.description: When the shared SSE contract, the aura state machine, or the phase labels change, ask the agent to update the spec so the documented mapping matches the code.

action.prompt: A file that defines the SSE-to-3D contract was just saved. Compare AgentPhase, StageId, NodeStatus and AgentEvent in lib/types.ts, auraFromState in lib/aura.ts, and the PHASE_LABEL / PHASE_META maps in components/ControlPanel.tsx and components/StatusPill.tsx against the 'SSE-to-3D state mapping' and 'Components and interfaces' sections of .kiro/specs/necrocode-exorcist/design.md. If they differ, update design.md (and requirements.md if an acceptance criterion changed). Do not change application code.
